$description: Foundation color palette for the Rollups marketing site clone. Every value cited from src/index.css :root custom properties and tailwind.config.js theme.extend.colors — the two files agree (spot-checked). This does NOT include the /get-started (SignUp, app.rollups.com clone) palette, which is a structurally separate, intentionally different token system — see tokens/00-foundation/color.signup.json.

light-100.usage: primary text on dark green background, primary button text color

green-deep.measuredFrom: tailwind.config.js:11, src/index.css body background-image start stop
green-deep.usage: page background gradient start, html background-color

green-dark.measuredFrom: tailwind.config.js:12, src/index.css body background-image end stop

black.usage: reserved dark tone (not observed as a direct background in sampled components)

light-bg.usage: light background context (SignUp-adjacent / light surface, rare on marketing pages)

tint.usage: learn-more icon circle fill, faq icon circle fill, cookie-consent panel fill
